faq.title: Help / FAQ
faq.q_coordinates: What does the coordinate format 049.8 / 038.5 mean?
faq.a_coordinates: The coordinates match the in-game format. The 3 digits before the decimal are the 100m grid (as shown on the in-game map), the decimal shows the 10m position. Example: 049.8 = 4980m from map edge. Format is: East / North.
faq.q_mortarPos: How do I set the mortar position?
faq.a_mortarPos: Left-click on the map sets the mortar position (blue marker). Height is automatically determined from map data.
faq.q_targetPos: How do I set the target?
faq.a_targetPos: Right-click or Shift+click on the map sets the target position (red marker). Alternatively: Ctrl+click or Alt+click.
faq.q_circles: What do the colored circles mean?
faq.a_circles: The circles show the ranges of different charge levels (Ring 0-4). Green = close, Red = far. The active ring is filled with color.
faq.a_deadzone: The dark red inner circle marks the minimum range. Targets in this area cannot be hit.
faq.q_autoRing: How does automatic ring selection work?
faq.a_autoRing: The optimal ring is automatically calculated based on the distance to target. Lower rings = shorter flight time = higher precision.
faq.q_azimuthElevation: What do azimuth and elevation mean?
faq.a_azimuthElevation: Azimuth = direction in MIL (0-6400). Elevation = angle in MIL. Set these values on the mortar.
faq.a_savePositions: Use the "Stations" and "Missions" panels to save frequently used positions and quickly recall them.
